task.title: To reload the X-Author for Contracts Advanced add-in pane

step.cmd: Log in to X-Author for Contracts Advanced.
Click the Left Arrow button () on the top right corner of the X-Author for Contracts Advanced pane. or

ul.li: If you are using a Mac user, click the Information button () on the top right corner of the X-Author for Contracts Advanced pane.

step.cmd: The X-Author for Contracts pane is reloaded. When you reload the X-Author for Contract Advanced pane, all changes you made while working on the document are retained. You will not lose any information because of reloading.
